title: THE ULTIMATE CHINESE GRAVEL FRAMESET CARBONDA 696?

takeaways.text: In mid-2020 the frame, fork, seatpost and clamp cost US$480; with thru-axles, two spare hangers, UPS express and the PayPal fee the order reached about US$727 delivered to the US.
The seller first said the 56 cm BB86 frame was in stock, then said after payment that it needed about two weeks to make; communication was otherwise responsive and the order arrived in four weeks.
Small parts: seatpost 176 g (170 g claimed), thru-axle pair 76 g, threaded hanger with bolt 19 g, seatpost clamp 19 g; about 62 g of frame bolts in total.
The reviewer pointed out a small area on the fork where the finish looked thin, like a worn tire tread, without saying whether it was structural.
The 56 cm BB86 frame weighed 1,320 g with all bolts, hanger and routing parts fitted and 1,225 g stripped; the fork weighed 568 g with hardware (546 g stripped).
Repeats the seller's clearance of 700×50C or 650B×2.1 in; the video does not test-fit those sizes.

disclosure: The creator bought the frameset and itemises what he paid; the description links Carbonda's product page and a builds forum thread.
summary: Unboxing and weigh-in before the owner's build: about US$727 delivered with axles, spare hangers and express shipping, a size 56 frame at about 1,225 g without bolts and a 546 g fork, plus the ordering process.
